scenarios.title: Unauthorised visitor is blocked from viewing the main page
given: A visitor who is not authorised
scenarios.when: The visitor navigates to the main page
then: The visitor is prevented from seeing the main page content
The visitor is presented with an indication that authorization is required

scenarios.title: Generate and display authorization QR code separately from the main page
given: A visitor who is not authorised
scenarios.when: The visitor accesses the separate authorization interface to request an authorization QR code
then: An authorization QR code is generated and displayed
The main page content remains hidden while the QR code is displayed

scenarios.title: Complete authorization via the QR code to gain access to the main page
given: An unauthorised visitor who has displayed the authorization QR code
The authorization has been completed using the QR code
scenarios.when: The visitor accesses the main page
then: The visitor is recognized as authorised
The main page content is fully displayed to the visitor

scenarios.title: Authorised visitor directly accesses the main page
given: A visitor who is already authorised
scenarios.when: The visitor navigates to the main page
then: The main page content is displayed without requiring QR code authorization

scenarios.title: Attempting to access main page while QR authorization remains incomplete
given: An unauthorised visitor has generated the authorization QR code
Authorization via the QR code has not yet been completed
scenarios.when: The visitor attempts to access the main page
then: The main page content is not displayed
The visitor is prompted to complete authorization
